column1: The first data set is the conductance vs. gate voltage across the interferometer across the 1/3 state. The second data set is the bulk transport Rxx and Rxy. The third data set is conductance data focusing on the clear discrete phase jump

Conductance versus magnetic field and  gate voltage. Magnetic field is in the first row in units of T, gate voltage is in the first column in units of V and relative to -1.0V. Conductance is in units of e^2/h.

Conductance versus magnetic field and  gate voltage focused on discrete phase jump. Magnetic field is in the first row in units of T, gate voltage is in the first column in units of V and relative to -1.0V. Conductance is in units of e^2/h.
